FINAL EXECUTION DIRECTIVE — COMPLETE IVX END TO END

Stop repeating the same environment diagnostics.

Yesterday's audits and today's reports already collected ownership evidence, repository evidence, deployment evidence, recovery evidence, and production evidence.

Do not restart the investigation.

Treat the existing audit evidence as the baseline and continue execution.

Your responsibility is to complete IVX end to end.

Only report items that still require engineering work.

Execute in this order:

1. Verify the canonical repository (ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform) is the production source of truth.

2. Verify GitHub HEAD, Render deployed SHA, and live /version SHA still match. If they do not, reconcile and redeploy safely.

3. Complete all remaining CI failures until required production checks pass. Do not rerun completed checks unnecessarily.

4. Complete end-to-end production QA:
   - Member registration
   - Member sign-in
   - Owner sign-in
   - Owner Dashboard
   - Members
   - Investors
   - Buyers
   - Properties
   - Deals
   - Reels
   - IVX IA Chat
   - OTP verification
   - Android
   - iOS (or approved iOS validation)
   - Web

5. Verify the primary AI provider is active and fallback is only used during genuine provider failures.

6. Verify production security:
   - No plaintext OTP storage
   - Authorization boundaries
   - Owner-only access
   - Secret handling
   - Production environment integrity

7. Produce the final production certification containing only:
   - GitHub repository
   - Final GitHub HEAD SHA
   - Final merged SHA
   - Render deployment ID
   - Live /version SHA
   - SHA parity result
   - CI result
   - Member registration result
   - Member sign-in result
   - Owner sign-in result
   - Android result
   - iOS result
   - Web result
   - Primary AI result
   - Remaining production blockers, if any

Do not repeat completed ownership audits or environment reports.

If a platform limitation still prevents authenticated operations, identify the single exact limitation with evidence and stop there.

Otherwise continue automatically until IVX production is fully completed and verified.
